item.title: Good Morning Australia - 21 May 2026
item.description:
Good morning Australia!
Today is Thursday, the 21 May.
In Bendigo today, it will be mostly sunny, with a low of 6 degrees and a top of 15 degrees. There is about a 0 percent chance of rain. You might need a warm jumper today.
Today’s letter is K. Can you think of something that starts with K?
Today’s number is 1. Can you clap 1 times?
Today’s Australian animal is the koala. Did you know? Koalas sleep for many hours because gum leaves do not give them much energy.
